items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Ralph Flanagan to us was the lowest.

ctx.x: I’m trying to place the pop music that was going on in the early ‘50s too. It wasn’t quite rock & roll yet.

Well they confused us with Ralph Flanagan, that’s probably the biggest insult you could give us because Ralph Flanagan to us was the lowest. But some idiot at RCA confused the name Flanagan with Finegan.
